description_zh: 调用CreateDedicatedHostAccount接口创建主机账户
kebab_example: aliyun cddc create-dedicated-host-account --dedicated-host-id ch-bp10a5id3boqi0000 --account-name test --account-password testxxxxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --bastion-instance-id bastionhost-cn-xxxxxxxxxxx --account-type Admin --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCz0000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDedicatedHostAccount

parameters.help_en: The host ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200944.html operation to obtain this ID
parameters.name: dedicated_host_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the host account. The name must meet the following requirements:

- The name must be 2 to 16 characters in length.

- The name must start with a letter and end with a letter or a digit.

- The name can contain only lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (\_)
parameters.help_zh:
自定义主机账号名称。
* 长度为2~16个字符。
* 以字母开头，以字母或数字结尾。
* 由小写字母、数字、下划线（_）组成
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en:
The password for the host account. The password must meet the following requirements:

- The password must be 6 to 32 characters in length.

- It must contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.

- Supported special characters: `!@#$%^&*()_+-=`

> If your engine is SQL Server, the password cannot contain the account name (case-insensitive)
parameters.help_zh:
主机账号名的密码。密码要求：
* 长度为6~32位。
* 大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符。
* 特殊字符为：`!@#$%^&*()_+-=`

> 您的引擎为SQL Server时，密码要求不能包含账户名（忽略大小写）
parameters.name: account_password

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/213010.html operation to obtain this ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the bastion instance. You can find this ID on the **Bastion Instance List** page of the Cloud Database Dedicated Cluster (CDDC) console
parameters.help_zh: 关联的堡垒机ID，可以在云数据库专属集群控制台**堡垒机列表**查看
parameters.name: bastion_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the host account. Valid values:

- **Normal**: A normal account.

- **Admin**: An administrator account.

For more information about host account permissions, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/176240.html
parameters.help_zh:
主机账号类型，取值：
- **Normal**：普通账号。
- **Admin**： 管理员账号。

关于主机账号的权限说明，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/176240.html
parameters.name: account_type

parameters.help_en: A client-generated token that ensures request idempotence. The token is a string of up to 64 ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 由客户端生成该参数值，用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。字符长度不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token
